seo.title_so: BajGo — Safar iyo dirid Bajaaj ah oo Garoowe ah
seo.title_en: BajGo — Bajaaj rides and deliveries in Garowe
seo.description_so: BajGo waa app-ka Bajaajta ee Garoowe ee safarka iyo dirista alaabta. Ku dalbo Bajaaj ama dir xirmo dhowr taabasho, arag lacagta ka hor intaadan bixin, oo si toos ah ula soco darawalkaaga.
seo.description_en: BajGo is Garowe's on-demand Bajaaj app for rides and deliveries. Book a Bajaaj or send a parcel in a few taps, see your fare before you go, and track your driver live.

so.headline: Garoowe, hal taabasho.
so.sub: Ku dalbo Bajaaj ama dir xirmo dhowr taabasho, arag lacagta ka hor intaadan bixin, oo si toos ah ula soco darawalkaaga.

en.headline: Garowe, one tap away.
en.sub: Book a Bajaaj or send a parcel in a few taps, see your fare before you go, and track your driver live.

cards.title: BajGo Ride
cards.body: Ku dalbo Bajaaj meel kasta oo aad u socoto.

cards.title: BajGo Delivery
cards.body: Dir xirmooyin, cunto, dukumeenti iyo alaab.

cards.title: BajGo Ride
cards.body: Book a Bajaaj to take you anywhere.

cards.title: BajGo Delivery
cards.body: Send packages, food, documents and shopping.

steps.title: Dooro meesha
steps.body: Qor meesha aad joogto iyo meesha aad u socoto, ama biinka khariidadda ka dhig.

steps.title: Arag qiimaha
steps.body: Qiimaha saxda ah ayaa lagu tusayaa ka hor intaadan xaqiijin. Wax yaab ah ma jiro.

steps.title: La soco darawalkaaga
steps.body: Arag darawalka, koodhka gaariga iyo meesha uu joogo si toos ah.

steps.title: Choose your places
steps.body: Type where you are and where you're going, or drop a pin on the map.

steps.title: See your fare
steps.body: The exact fare is shown before you confirm. No surprises.

steps.title: Track your driver
steps.body: See your driver, their fleet code and their live location.

so.title: Qiimaha ka hor intaadan bixin
so.body: Qiimaha bilowga waa $0.50 kiiloomitirkii, ugu yaraan $1.00. Qiimaha saxda ah ee waddadaada waxaad arkaysaa app-ka ka hor intaadan xaqiijin.

en.title: Fare before you go
en.body: Launch pricing is $0.50 per km with a $1.00 minimum. You see the exact fare for your route in the app before you confirm.

so.title: Soo deji app-ka. Dalbo safarkaaga ugu horreeya maanta.
so.body: App-ka macmiilka wuxuu u shaqeeyaa Android iyo iPhone. Darawallada waxay helaan app gaar ah.

en.title: Get the app. Book your first ride today.
en.body: The customer app works on Android and iPhone. Drivers get a separate app.

so.title: La shaqee BajGo. Safarro badan, dakhli caddaalad ah, Bajaajkaaga.
so.body: Darawallada BajGo waa shuraako. Waxaad aragtaa dakhliga safar kasta, oo waxaad shaqaysaa waqtiga kugu habboon.
so.label: Noqo darawal

en.title: Drive with BajGo. More trips. Fair pay. Your Bajaaj.
en.body: BajGo drivers are partners. You see the earnings for every trip, and you work the hours that suit you.
en.label: Become a driver

steps.title: Darawallo la hubiyay
steps.body: Darawal kasta aqoonsigiisa, shatigiisa iyo Bajaajkiisa ayaa la hubiyaa ka hor intuusan bilaabin.

steps.title: Koodh gaari oo muuqda
steps.body: Isku hubi koodhka gaariga, sida BG-0142, ka hor intaadan fuulin.

steps.title: Wadaag safarkaaga
steps.body: U dir qof aad ku kalsoon tahay xiriirin uu kula socdo safarkaaga.

steps.title: Verified drivers
steps.body: Every driver's ID, licence and Bajaaj are checked before they start.

steps.title: Visible fleet code
steps.body: Check the fleet code, such as BG-0142, before you get in.

steps.title: Share your trip
steps.body: Send someone you trust a link to follow your trip.
